pages.en:
Shanghai Municipal Council.

October 21st 191

POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
After 7 p.m. on the 20th inst, the sentries and
patrols were doubled at and around the City and Arsenal.
General Yang has invited all the prominent merchants
and officials to be present at the distribution of
repatriation funds which will begin to-day at 8 a.m.
near the Kau Tsaung Miao 高昌廟.
Colonel Wang Ping 王賓 of Loongwha has received
instructions to turn out as many troops as he can to insure
the maintainance of order at the distribution of the
funds. In view of the activities of those rebels who
are not satisfied with the amount of the grant it is
anticipated that only about 3/10 of the whole will present
themselves to receive the money. Dr. Sun Yat Sen
was interviewed on the above subject by representatives
of the rebels on the 20th inst and he informed them
that he had nothing whatever to do with the repatriation
scheme.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
上海工部局。

191年10月21日

警务处，
（侦探科。）

先生：

本月20日晚7时后，兵工厂及其周边地区的哨兵和巡逻队已加倍部署。杨将军已邀请所有知名商人和官员出席遣散费的发放仪式，该仪式将于今日上午8时在高昌庙附近开始。

龙华的王宾上校已接到指令，调集尽可能多的部队，以确保遣散费发放期间的秩序维持。鉴于那些对拨款金额不满的叛乱分子的活动，预计仅有约十分之三的人员会前来领取款项。孙中山博士于本月20日就上述事项接受了叛乱分子代表的问询，他向他们表示，他与遣散计划毫无关系。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警务处总监。
